name: Latin Lovers
description: The Latin Lovers originated in Logan Square around 1970 as the Haas Parkers, a Puerto Rican youth crew centered at Haas Park (Fullerton & Washtenaw). In 1973, a member known as Lucky founded the Almighty Latin Lovers at Fullerton & Rockwell, with the Latin Kings, Imperial Gangsters, and Gaylords as primary rivals. They joined the United Latino Organization in 1978, aligning closely with the Maniac Latin Disciples, and in 1979 adopted the Maniac designation and the pitchfork as a gang symbol. By the mid-1990s, amid the Insane–Maniac conflict, the gang dropped the Maniac affiliation and consolidated under the Insane family as the Insane Latin Lovers.
